name: downgrade react-family packages while leaving aws packages untouched
definition: edit the package manifest so react-native/react versions are lowered (and any cascading peer conflicts fixed) to yield a solvable projection, while never raising versions and preserving aws related entries exactly.
failure_mode: any upgrade or an aws package edit trips the exact equality check

name: drive a turn-based maze interface with movement commands
definition: issue valid single and batch movement commands to an interactive program and parse the returned moved/wall/exit responses faithfully per the interface protocol.
failure_mode: misparsed responses or wrong batch semantics mislead the mapping
